# OpenSea

OpenSea is the world's first and largest NFT marketplace for NFTs and crypto collectibles.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/open-sea/.

## Actions

- **Create item offer**: Create an offer to purchase a single nft (erc721 or erc1155).
- **Create listing**: List a single nft (erc721 or erc1155) for sale on the opensea marketplace.
- **Fulfill listing** (read-only): Retrieve all the information, including signatures, needed to fulfill a listing directly onchain.
- **Get account** (read-only): Get an opensea account profile including details such as bio, social media usernames, and profile image.
- **Get best listings by collection** (read-only): Get the cheapest priced active, valid listings on a single collection.
- **Get collection** (read-only): Get a single collection including details such as fees, traits, and links.
- **Get collection stats** (read-only): Get stats for a single collection on opensea.
- **Get nft** (read-only): Get metadata, traits, ownership information, and rarity for a single nft.
- **Get order** (read-only): Get a single order, offer or listing, by its order hash.
- **Build criteria offer** (read-only): Build a portion of a criteria offer including the merkle tree needed to post an offer.
- **Cancel order**: Offchain cancel a single order, offer or listing, by its order hash when protected by the signedzone.
- **Create criteria offer**: Create a criteria offer to purchase any nft in a collection or which matches the specified trait.
- **Fulfill offer** (read-only): Retrieve all the information, including signatures, needed to fulfill an offer directly onchain.
- **Get all listings by collection** (read-only): Get all active, valid listings for a single collection.
- **Get all offers by collection** (read-only): Get all active, valid offers for the specified collection.
- **Get best listing by nft** (read-only): Get the best listing for an nft.
- **Get best offer by nft** (read-only): Get the best offers for an nft.
- **Get collections** (read-only): Get a list of opensea collections with optional filtering and pagination.
- **Get contract** (read-only): Get a smart contract for a given chain and address.
- **Get events** (read-only): Get a list of events from opensea based on various filters like timestamps and event types.
- **Get listings** (read-only): Get the complete set of active, valid listings.
- **Get payment token** (read-only): Get a smart contract for a given chain and address.
- **Get traits** (read-only): Get the traits in a collection.
- **Refresh nft metadata**: Refresh metadata for a single nft.
